- **My files in the full run:** `search.test.ts` 19/19, `search-parity.test.ts` 2/2, BE-P's `index-feed.test.ts` 17/17 and `security.test.ts` 8/8.
- **The 4 failures:** they are the same kind D-201 and BE-P already record.

  - `response-validation.test.ts`, "P5 BE-J operations": `expected [] to have a length of 1`.
  - `forms/form-records.test.ts`, "at most 5000 rows": 60 s timeout.

The run started at 21:38 and ended at 23:12 UTC, and `integration.log` is now complete. I've updated rows 9 and 9c and §7 of the handback; the re-run log is `integration-rerun-3-files.log`.

Three things remain for the orchestrator on the merged tree:
- `pnpm test` with `C.UTF-8` (never run).
- `pnpm test` with the locale unset (my run hit its timeout before finishing).
- A clean `pnpm -r build` (the last one was killed for memory).
